sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on hn volute casings.
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our contract requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110), so the change cannot take effect on the date you announce.
Your rolling on-time delivery to 2026Q3 stands at 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3).
Electric power generation producer prices (PPI-D351) changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 8,150 pcs per year over 12 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and volume change data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have verified your official forecast and appreciate the binding commitment to 8,150 pieces per year. The labour cost index data you cited aligns with our own records, confirming the ongoing cost pressures we face. In recognition of your increased volume and the 14-day payment terms, we are prepared to lower our price to €131.50 per unit. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our updated Angebot stands at a price of €131.50 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

We have received your updated offer and appreciate your willingness to move. Over the many years of our partnership, we have always valued working together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. 

Without new data to change the underlying facts, our room for further concessions is very limited. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

To bring this negotiation to a successful close, we can offer a price of €129.80 per unit. Alternatively, our current Angebot stands at a price of €131.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Furthermore, we can offer a package at a price of €129.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Alternatively, with valid from 1 November 2026: €129.80 per unit.

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
